info resource-folded: appdb (Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL/flexibleServers/databases) is folded into the instance of flexibleservers, written at values.database
warn substrate-left-to-operator: the source creates substrate the draft leaves to the operator and drafts nothing for: vnet-core (Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks), of which the format says the network a component runs in is the operator's: a component of the catalog takes it by its resource ID under infra.overrides, reading the parameter location at location; provide each where the Release deploys, and fill the pointers the Release leaves for them
warn value-not-carried: web sets the variable DB_NAME in the environment of the instance web, and the draft delivers an instance's environment from its connections alone, so the variable is not carried: the instance's Release entry names it, for the author to set where the instance is configured
